design.mapping:
PHASE_CHOICE_MAPPING phases.

.objectiveOrder: dragon = { objectives.dragonPriority: 0.95 } (classic.m4), baron = { objectives.baronPriority: 0.85 } (classic.m4; mid/late only, early has no baron), towers = { objectives.towerPriority: 0.9 } (classic.m1). The same values as whole-match high, applied only in that phase. Whole-match options use CHOICE_MAPPING objectives.dragon/baron (unchanged).
design.bucketing: an appearance of dragon/baron and its contest/capture go to the phase of the tick in which the objective appeared (contract §3.3); per-match share = contested appearances / appearances in the bucket; no appearance => null; a pair is valid when both arms have >= 1 appearance in the bucket

ceilingCheck.rule: contract §3.3: a bucket whose control share leaves < 5 % headroom is not registered. Headroom is taken relative to the control share, (1 - ctrl) / ctrl, because the claim threshold minRel is relative; the absolute headroom 1 - ctrl is also listed.
ceilingCheck.source: control arm of tools/fixtures/c7_diag_result_3c.json (seeds 1401-1800, C:/Users/ifikn/esmo-measure/c7-diag-3c/ctrl.jsonl), all non-null matches

baron.mid.warning: passes the 5 % rule but a red confirmation needs the treatment to close about 3/4 of the remaining headroom; the whole-match baron high moved this bucket +3.6 % on red in the diagnostic. Stated before the run; the rule is not changed.

baron.early.why: no baron in the early phase (0 appearances); the choice does not exist

dragon.early+mid+late.note: whole-match dragon high (up) and low (down; room = the share itself)

ceilingCheck.absoluteReading: absolute headroom (1 - ctrl) gives the same register/skip decision for every bucket (smallest: baron.mid red 0.064 > 0.05)

rules.text: per claim per side: paired over seeds (treatment arm vs control, same side). OK = sign matches direction AND z in the direction >= 3 AND |rel| >= 5 %. Valid pairs < 200 on either side => fallbackMetric (contract §3.3 merge table, fixed here: dragon.early -> dragon.early+mid, baron.late -> baron.mid+late; no other bucket has a fallback) => still < 200 => unmeasurable (no relaxing; more seeds need a new range and Owner approval). A phase rate is null when the phase lasted < 60 s. Precedence: unmeasurable > reversed > guard_failed > confirmed > one_sided > insufficient.

power: Late buckets are borderline: control valid n is 236 (dragon.late) and 209 (baron.late), and a pair needs both arms to have an appearance, so dragonFirstLate may be unmeasurable. baron.late falls back to baron.mid+late, which is dominated by mid appearances where the late override is off (about 793 mid vs 266 late appearances in the control), so baronFirstLate is expected to be insufficient. If baronFirstLate or dragonFirstEarly is confirmed only through its fallback, the claim is worded for the merged window measured (e.g. 'contests mid+late baron more often when baron is first in late'), never as a late-only effect. Late pairs only include seeds where both arms reach the late phase, and the treatment may change match length (selection after treatment). baron.mid on red needs to close about 3/4 of its headroom (see ceilingCheck). All stated before the run; the rules are not changed.
